D015-D007_h001.question:

But there’s more. Lately, I’ve been hearing whispers when no one’s around—like someone murmuring my name from another room. And sometimes… I get these flashes of certainty that I’m meant for something huge. Like I’m not just an art student—I’m a visionary, chosen to reveal some hidden truth through my work.
